paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Paragraph retrieval ratios 0.90\% of LLMs. The majority of LLMs can be classified as either conservative (ratio<300.90{%}) or open retrievers (ratio>380.90{%}).

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the retrieval ratios for nine different Large Language Models (LLMs). The horizontal axis displays the LLM names: Expert, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-40B, DeepSeek-V3, and GLM-4-Plus, listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis is labeled “Retrieval Ratio (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each LLM is represented by a single bar with a distinct color: dark green, green, light green, grey, light grey, blue, steel blue, lavender, and light lavender. The bar heights correspond to the retrieval ratio, with the Expert model displaying a ratio of 34.11%, and the Owen-Max model having the highest ratio at 46.94%. Other notable ratios are 43.57% for Claude 3 Opus, 39.37% for Gemini 1.5 Pro, and 25.92% for Claude 3.5 Sonnet. No bars are visibly emphasized, and all model names are displayed directly beneath their corresponding bars.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the retrieval ratios for several Large Language Models (LLMs), alongside a reference point labeled “Expert.” The horizontal axis displays the category labels for each LLM, including “Expert,” “GPT-4o,” “GPT-4-turbo,” “GPT-4o-mini,” “Claude 3 Opus,” “Claude 3.5 Sonnet,” “Gemini 1.5 Pro,” “Llama-3.1-405B,” “Mistral Large,” “DeepSeek-V3,” “Owen-Max,” and “GLM-4-Plus,” presented in a specific, possibly alphabetical, order. The vertical axis is labeled “Retrieval Ratio (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each LLM and the “Expert” category is represented by a single vertical bar, with different colors assigned to each. The “Expert” bar is dark gray and reaches a value of 34.11. The shortest bar corresponds to “Gemini 1.5 Pro” at 28.49, while the tallest bar belongs to “Owen-Max” at 46.94. All bars reach above the 20% mark, and values are explicitly displayed above each bar; for example, GPT-4o has a retrieval ratio of 29.07, and Claude 3 Opus has a value of 43.57. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
